https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.body: Senior Special Assistant to the President on Digital and New Media, Otega Ogra, said the Federal Government immediately deployed military and intelligence assets to Oyo State following the incident. Ogra, in a post on his X handle, said the operations led to the successful rescue of all the abducted children and teachers on July 10, 2026. His response followed Makinde’s disclosure during an interview that he did not speak with President Tinubu throughout the over 50 days the victims were held captive, despite attempts to reach the President through his aide. Addressing the governor directly, Ogra said the federal government remained focused on its mandate to secure and prosper Nigeria under President Tinubu. He maintained that the President prioritised concrete action and results over political point-scoring in addressing security challenges. According to him, the administration has introduced measures to strengthen the country’s security architecture, including the creation of a new Homeland Security position, improved coordination under the Office of the National Security Adviser (ONSA), and better equipment and remuneration for the military. He added that the government had also improved welfare across the security and intelligence agencies. On Makinde’s comments regarding the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC), Ogra stressed that the anti-graft agency remained independent and carried out its statutory responsibilities without political interference. He said President Tinubu had consistently maintained a non-interference policy regarding agencies and regulatory bodies with statutory independence. Ogra, however, criticised the governor’s comments, urging him to concentrate on governance and issue-based campaigning. “In my opinion, sir, political leaders like your good self should prioritise governance or focus on issues-based campaigning rather than such grandstanding that is now becoming the hallmark of your campaign,” he said. https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.body_zh: 总统数字与新媒体事务高级特别助理奥泰加·奥格拉表示，事件发生后，联邦政府立即向奥约州调配了军事和情报资源。奥格拉在其X账号发帖称，相关行动于2026年7月10日成功解救了所有被绑架的儿童和教师。此前，马金德在一次采访中透露，在受害者遭拘禁的50多天里，尽管他曾试图通过总统助手联系蒂努布总统，但一直没有与总统通话。奥格拉直接回应州长称，在蒂努布总统领导下，联邦政府始终专注于确保尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）安全、实现繁荣这一使命。他坚持认为，在应对安全挑战时，总统更重视实际行动和成效，而非争取政治得分。据他介绍，当局已推出多项措施加强国家安全体系，包括新设国土安全职位、加强国家安全顾问办公室（ONSA）统筹协调，以及改善军队装备和薪酬。他还表示，政府也提升了安全和情报机构的整体福利。针对马金德有关经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）的评论，奥格拉强调，这个反腐机构仍保持独立，并在不受政治干预的情况下履行法定职责。他说，蒂努布总统始终奉行不干预依法独立运行之机构及监管部门的政策。不过，奥格拉批评了州长的言论，敦促他专注于治理和以具体问题为基础的竞选活动。他说：“依我之见，先生，像您这样优秀的政治领导人，应当优先关注治理或围绕具体问题开展竞选，而不是像现在这样大做姿态，而这正逐渐成为您竞选活动的标志。”我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕消息和独家视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地接收全天候最新消息 →

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body: Former Jigawa State Governor and PDP chieftain, Sule Lamido, has dismissed President Bola Tinubu, former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar and former Anambra State Governor, Peter Obi, as unsuitable options for Nigeria ahead of the 2027 general election. Lamido stated this during an interview on Channels Television’s Politics Today on Friday, where he was asked which of the three political figures could attract the Northern vote in the forthcoming presidential election. Giving his assessment, the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) chieftain said none of the three contenders was in a position to address Nigeria’s challenges. He said, “Look, from my own personal opinion, in my view, voting should depend on who is the person with the right kind of quality and calibre to be able to address the same problem. Peter Obi, Tinubu, Atiku — none of them is there for Nigeria.” The former Jigawa governor also declared his support for the PDP’s presidential candidate, Professor Sandy Onor, insisting that he remained committed to the opposition party and would not vote for Tinubu in 2027. Asked whether he had endorsed Tinubu for a second term, Lamido said he remained a PDP member and would vote for his party’s candidate. He said, “I am PDP through and through. I am voting for my candidate, Professor Sandy Onor; that is my candidate. What I’m saying is that we have somebody called Professor Onor on that ballot. I’m voting him.” Lamido’s remarks come amid controversy over claims that he had endorsed Tinubu’s re-election bid after Vice-President Kashim Shettima reportedly listed him among former Jigawa governors backing the President ahead of 2027. https://leadership.ng/efcc-recovered-pip.summary: The company said the clarification became necessary following media reports on the EFCC’s recovery of outstanding pipeline transportation fees from oil companies, which mentioned Nembe, formerly known as Aiteo Eastern Exploration and Production Company Limited, alongside Newcross Exploration and Production Limited. https://leadership.ng/efcc-recovered-pip.summary_zh: 该公司表示，在媒体报道经济和金融犯罪委员会向石油企业追缴拖欠管道运输费后，有必要作出澄清。相关报道提及了Nembe、此前名为Aiteo Eastern Exploration and Production Company Limited的公司，以及Newcross Exploration and Production Limited。该公司强调，追回的资金是使用相关设施的石油企业向合资企业支付的管道运输服务费，而不是从Nembe追回的资金。
https://leadership.ng/efcc-recovered-pip.body: The company said the clarification became necessary following media reports on the EFCC’s recovery of outstanding pipeline transportation fees from oil companies, which mentioned Nembe, formerly known as Aiteo Eastern Exploration and Production Company Limited, alongside Newcross Exploration and Production Limited. According to the company, the reports created a misleading impression that Nembe was among the companies from which the EFCC recovered the funds. Nembe explained that it operated the Nembe Creek Trunkline (NCTL) on behalf of its joint venture with NNPCL and provided crude oil transportation services to third-party operators, including Newcross Exploration and Production Limited. It said the outstanding fees arose from the use of the pipeline by these operators, adding that Nembe was responsible for pursuing the payments on behalf of the JV. The company noted that crude oil theft, pipeline vandalism, insecurity and operational disruptions, particularly since the COVID-19 period, had affected pipeline operations, transportation volumes and reconciliation of payments. It said it made repeated efforts to recover the outstanding fees through formal demands, correspondence and engagements with the affected parties before the EFCC intervened. Nembe explained that the commission’s statutory investigative and recovery powers helped secure the funds it had been pursuing on behalf of the JV. It stressed that the recovered money represented payment for pipeline transportation services owed to the JV by oil firms that used the facility, not funds recovered from Nembe. The company maintained that it was the operator responsible for pursuing the outstanding payments and was not the defaulting party. It added that the recovery should be understood as the settlement of outstanding service fees rather than evidence of wrongdoing or financial misconduct by Nembe. The company also suggested that changes in the EFCC’s leadership may have contributed to the confusion surrounding the recovery, insisting that it was not indebted to the JV in respect of the pipeline transportation fees. On a separate matter, Nembe said stamp duty arising from the acquisition of Oil Mining Lease (OML) 29 and the Nembe Creek Trunkline remained under reconciliation with the relevant statutory authorities. It emphasised that the stamp duty issue was distinct from the outstanding pipeline transportation fees recovered by the EFCC. The company welcomed the recovery, saying it represented revenue due to the joint venture. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/efcc-recovered-pip.title_zh: 经济和金融犯罪委员会追回欠缴合资企业费用的石油企业款项——Nembe作出澄清
https://leadership.ng/efcc-recovered-pip.body_zh: 该公司表示，在媒体报道经济和金融犯罪委员会从石油公司追回未付管道运输费后，有必要作出澄清。相关报道提及了Nembe（前身为Aiteo Eastern Exploration and Production Company Limited）以及Newcross Exploration and Production Limited。据该公司称，这些报道造成了误导印象，使人以为Nembe是经济和金融犯罪委员会追回资金的公司之一。Nembe解释说，它代表其与尼日利亚管道与储运公司的合资企业运营Nembe Creek Trunkline（NCTL），并向包括Newcross Exploration and Production Limited在内的第三方运营商提供原油运输服务。该公司说，未付费用源于这些运营商使用该管道，并补充称，Nembe负责代表合资企业追讨相关款项。该公司指出，原油盗采、管道遭破坏、安全局势恶化及运营中断，尤其是自新冠疫情时期以来，已对管道运营、运输量和付款核对造成影响。它表示，在经济和金融犯罪委员会介入之前，公司曾通过正式催款函、函件以及与相关方的接洽，多次努力追回未付费用。Nembe解释说，该委员会的法定调查和追缴权力有助于 secured 其代表合资企业追讨的资金。它强调，追回的资金是使用该设施的石油企业欠付合资企业的管道运输服务费，并非从Nembe追回的资金。该公司坚持称，它是负责追讨未付款项的运营方，并非违约方。它补充说，此次追缴应被理解为未付服务费的结清，而非Nembe存在不当行为或财务违规的证据。该公司还表示，经济和金融犯罪委员会领导层的变动可能加剧了围绕此次追缴的混乱，并坚称其并未因管道运输费而欠付合资企业款项。在另一事项上，Nembe表示，因取得Oil Mining Lease（OML）29和Nembe Creek Trunkline而产生的印花税，仍在与相关法定机构进行核对。它强调，印花税问题与经济和金融犯罪委员会追回的未付管道运输费属于不同事项。该公司对此次追缴表示欢迎，称其代表应收合资企业的收入。我们掌握前沿动态。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角，直接送达您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp频道，随时随地接收最新消息 →

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 一份在土耳其安塔利亚举行的COP31气候峰会上发布的新国际白皮书，敦促各国政府把抽水蓄能水电作为战略基础设施予以优先发展，以加强能源安全并支持可再生电力扩张。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: A new international white paper launched at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, has urged governments to prioritise pumped-storage hydropower as strategic infrastructure to strengthen energy security and support the expansion of renewable electricity. The paper, developed with input from more than 60 governments and international agencies through the Global Alliance for Pumped Storage (GAPS), outlines seven policy recommendations for accelerating investment in the technology, which can store electricity for extended periods and release it when demand increases. It was presented at a high-level roundtable organised by GAPS, as countries consider how to strengthen electricity systems amid growing energy demand and the expansion of renewable energy. Pumped-storage hydropower uses surplus electricity to pump water from a lower reservoir to an upper reservoir. When electricity demand rises, the system releases stored water through turbines to generate electricity. Unlike conventional battery technologies, the system can store large amounts of energy for extended periods, while also providing services that help maintain electricity grid stability. The white paper argues that the technology could help countries reduce dependence on imported energy resources and strengthen domestic energy systems because it relies primarily on water, suitable geographical locations, and local labour, rather than imported or processed critical minerals. It also notes that projects can be developed using existing reservoirs, lakes, hydropower infrastructure and former mining sites. The paper identifies seven priority areas for governments seeking to accelerate pumped-storage development. These include assessing national energy-storage needs and incorporating them into electricity planning, recognising pumped storage as strategic national security infrastructure and establishing clear legal definitions for energy storage. It also recommends identifying and preparing suitable sites, simplifying permitting and licensing procedures, creating an enabling investment environment and ensuring that pumped-storage operators are adequately remunerated for the services they provide to electricity systems. According to the paper, significant upfront investment, lengthy development timelines and site-specific preparation requirements have continued to limit the development of pumped-storage projects despite their established capabilities. It argues that governments must create the necessary policy, regulatory and market conditions to attract investment while ensuring that projects meet environmental and social sustainability standards. The launch comes amid efforts to expand electricity access and increase the share of electricity in global energy consumption. Under the COP31 Global Electrification Pledge, countries are seeking to increase electricity’s share of final energy consumption from about 23 per cent currently to 35 per cent by 2035. Achieving this target will require electricity systems that can accommodate growing renewable energy generation while maintaining a reliable supply, the paper states. It identifies pumped storage as one of the established technologies that can provide long-duration energy storage alongside other grid services, including frequency and voltage control, operating reserves, and black-start capabilities, which allow electricity systems to restart after a major outage. President of the International Hydropower Association (IHA), Malcolm Turnbull, said countries seeking greater energy security and faster electrification could not afford to overlook the infrastructure required to support reliable electricity systems. Mr Turnbull said pumped storage represented a long-term investment in national energy security and sovereignty, adding that the white paper provided governments with recommendations to translate the technology’s potential into projects, investment and more resilient electricity systems. “As countries seek to become energy secure and accelerate electrification, we cannot afford to overlook the infrastructure that makes these systems work,” he said. The paper also highlights the potential economic benefits of pumped-storage projects, including employment opportunities through domestic resources and local labour. It argues that their long operational lifespans could make them important infrastructure investments for countries seeking to strengthen their electricity systems over generations

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 在土耳其安塔利亚举行的COP31气候峰会上发布的一份新国际白皮书敦促各国政府将抽水蓄能水电作为战略基础设施予以优先发展，以加强能源安全并支持可再生电力扩张。这份白皮书由全球抽水蓄能联盟（GAPS）汇集60多个政府和国际机构的意见制定，提出了七项政策建议，以加快对该技术的投资。抽水蓄能可以长时间储存电力，并在需求增加时释放电力。各国正在考虑如何在能源需求不断增长和可再生能源不断扩大的背景下加强电力系统之际，这份白皮书在GAPS组织的高级别圆桌会议上作了发布。抽水蓄能水电利用过剩电力将水从低处水库抽送至高处水库。当用电需求上升时，该系统通过水轮机释放储存的水以发电。传统电池技术不同，该系统能够长时间储存大量能源，同时提供有助于维持电网稳定的服务。白皮书认为，这项技术主要依靠水源、适宜的地理位置和本地劳动力，而非进口或加工的关键矿产，因此可以帮助各国减少对进口能源资源的依赖，并加强国内能源系统。白皮书还指出，可以利用现有水库、湖泊、水电基础设施和废弃矿区开发项目。报告确定了政府加快抽水蓄能发展的七个重点领域，包括评估国家储能需求并将其纳入电力规划，将抽水蓄能认定为国家安全的战略基础设施，并为储能确立明确的法律定义。报告还建议确定并准备适宜的场址，精简审批和许可程序，营造有利于投资的环境，并确保抽水蓄能运营商能够因其向电力系统提供的服务获得充分报酬。报告指出，尽管抽水蓄能项目的能力已经得到确立，但大额前期投资、漫长的开发周期以及针对具体场址的筹备要求，仍在限制这些项目的发展。报告认为，政府必须创造必要的政策、监管和市场条件来吸引投资，同时确保项目符合环境和社会可持续性标准。白皮书发布之际，各方正努力扩大电力接入，并提高电力在全球能源消费中的占比。根据COP31《全球电气化承诺》，各国正寻求将电力在终端能源消费中的占比从目前约23%提高至2035年的35%。报告称，实现这一目标需要能够容纳可再生能源发电量增长、同时维持可靠供电的电力系统。报告将抽水蓄能列为一种成熟技术，除提供长时储能外，还能提供频率和电压控制、运行备用以及黑启动能力等电网服务；其中黑启动能力使电力系统能够在发生重大停电后重新启动。国际水电协会（IHA）主席马尔科姆·特恩布尔表示，寻求更高能源安全水平和更快电气化的国家不能忽视支撑可靠电力系统所需的基础设施。特恩布尔先生说，抽水蓄能是对国家能源安全和主权的长期投资；这份白皮书为各国政府提出了建议，帮助其将这项技术的潜力转化为项目、投资和更具韧性的电力系统。他说：“随着各国寻求实现能源安全并加快电气化，我们不能忽视支撑这些系统运转所需的基础设施。”白皮书还强调了抽水蓄能项目的潜在经济效益，包括通过利用国内资源和本地劳动力创造就业机会。报告认为，漫长的运营寿命可以使这些项目成为重要基础设施投资，帮助各国在未来数代人期间加强其电力系统

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/apc-.body: ABUJA — The All Progressives Congress (APC), Italy Chapter, has dissociated itself from a purported party event scheduled to hold in Torino, Italy, on November 28, 2026, saying the gathering was not authorised by its leadership. The chapter urged party members and supporters in Italy and the diaspora to disregard the invitation, which advertised Hotel Royal Torino as the venue. The position was contained in a statement signed by the APC Italy Chairman and member of the APC-Diaspora Directorate of the Presidential Campaign Council, Amb. Prince Chima Ibezim. Ibezim said the party leadership in Italy and Nigeria had neither approved the event nor been formally informed of its organisation. “The attention of the APC Italy has been brought to a purported event in the name of the All Progressives Congress (APC) Italy Chapter, scheduled to hold in Torino on November 28, 2026, at Hotel Royal Torino. “The leadership of the party in Italy and Nigeria has not approved the event and is not aware of its organisation,” he said. Ibezim stated that the chapter had contacted Hotel Royal regarding the proposed gathering and was informed that no booking had been made for the event on the advertised date. He advised party members and supporters to avoid attending any gathering not officially communicated or endorsed by the recognised chapter leadership. The chairman said all official APC Italy programmes, activities and enquiries would be communicated through the chapter’s recognised leadership structure and authorised representatives. He urged members to rely on official party channels for information about its activities and engagements. https://www.myjoyonline.com/democracy-is.summary_zh: 奥蒂地区Dambai举行的一场公开论坛与会者呼吁加强有关买票行为的公众教育，并敦促政治人物在选举期间停止将选票货币化。他们还要求各政党和当选官员兑现对奥蒂地区民众作出的承诺，强调必须加强问责，并切实致力于发展。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/democracy-is.body: Participants at a public forum in Dambai in the Oti Region have called for increased public education on vote-buying and urged politicians to end the monetisation of votes during elections. They also want political parties and elected officials to fulfil promises made to the people of the Oti Region, stressing the need for greater accountability and commitment to development. The call was made during JoyNews' Democracy Is Not For Sale programme held at the Dambai College of Education, where students, residents and other stakeholders discussed the effects of vote buying on Ghana’s democratic process. Contributors at the forum said more public education was needed to help voters understand the long-term consequences of exchanging their votes for money and other material benefits. They argued that the practice undermines the integrity of elections and shifts attention from issues such as development, good governance and the ability of political candidates to serve their communities. Some participants urged political parties and aspirants to stop using money and other incentives to influence voters, insisting that electoral support should be based on policies, competence and the commitment of candidates to national and local development. The audience also called on politicians to honour promises made during election campaigns, particularly commitments to address the development needs of communities in the Oti Region. They stressed that residents should not be left with unfulfilled promises after elections, urging elected representatives to remain accessible and accountable to the people they serve. Persons with disabilities who participated in the programme also called for greater inclusion in the distribution of national resources and development opportunities. They emphasised the need for their concerns to be recognised in government policies and development programmes to ensure that they benefit from the country's resources and are not left behind. The discussions also highlighted the responsibility of citizens in protecting the democratic process, with participants encouraged to reject financial inducements and demand transparency from political leaders. The forum forms part of broader efforts to promote electoral integrity and encourage citizens to recognise their role in strengthening Ghana’s democracy
https://www.myjoyonline.com/democracy-is.title_zh: 民主不可买卖：Dambai居民要求加强问责和选民教育
https://www.myjoyonline.com/democracy-is.body_zh: 奥蒂地区丹拜一场公开论坛的参与者呼吁加强有关买票的公众教育，并敦促政治人物在选举期间停止选票货币化。他们还要求各政党和当选官员兑现对奥蒂地区人民作出的承诺，强调需要加强问责并致力于发展。此次呼吁是在JoyNews于丹拜教育学院举办的“民主不可买卖”活动中发出的，学生、居民和其他利益相关方在会上讨论了买票对加纳民主进程的影响。论坛发言者表示，需要开展更多公众教育，帮助选民了解用选票换取金钱和其他物质利益的长期后果。他们认为，这种做法破坏选举的诚信，并使人们的注意力从发展、良政以及政治候选人服务社区的能力等议题上转移开去。部分参与者敦促各政党和竞选者停止利用金钱和其他激励手段影响选民，坚持选票支持应建立在政策、能力以及候选人对国家和地方发展的承诺之上。听众还呼吁政治人物履行选举竞选期间作出的承诺，尤其是解决奥蒂地区各社区发展需求的承诺。他们强调，选举结束后不应让居民面对未兑现的承诺，并敦促当选代表继续亲近人民，对所服务的人民负责。参与该活动的残障人士还呼吁，在分配国家资源和发展机会时给予他们更多包容。他们强调，政府政策和 developmental programmes 需要承认他们的关切，确保他们能够分享国家发展的成果，而不会被落下。讨论还强调了公民在保护民主进程方面的责任，参与者受到鼓励，拒绝金钱诱惑，并要求政治领袖提高透明度。这场论坛是推动选举诚信、鼓励公民认识自己在加强加纳民主方面作用的一系列更广泛努力的一部分。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ondo.summary_zh: 第一层……称和解努力没有遗漏任何成员 奥恩多州全进步大会党（APC）否认了其领导人之间存在竞争和分裂的报道，宣布该党团结一致，已为2027年大选做好准备。他说，党员没有理由将彼此视为竞争对手，尤其是因为奥恩多州2027年不会举行州长选举，而蒂努布已成为该党唯一的总统候选人。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ondo.body: Layer 1 …Says no member is left out of reconciliation efforts The All Progressives Congress (APC) in Ondo State has dismissed reports of rivalry and divisions among its leaders, declaring that the party is united and ready for the 2027 general elections. The state chairman, Hon. Babatunde Kolawole, expressed confidence that the party would secure victories for President Bola Tinubu and its other candidates, insisting that ongoing reconciliation efforts were yielding positive results. Speaking with journalists in Akure, Kolawole said no member or interest group had been excluded from efforts to strengthen the party and bring all tendencies together. He said there was no reason for members to regard one another as rivals, particularly as Ondo State would not hold a governorship election in 2027 and Tinubu had emerged as the party’s sole presidential candidate. “Therefore, there is no rivalry. There is no cause for alarm. I can assure you we are on top of it and everything will be okay,” he said. Kolawole thanked Tinubu and the APC National Chairman for their support, while commending Senate Leader, Senator Michael Opeyemi Bamidele, and other party members for their contributions to the success of the presidential campaign. Also speaking, the Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign in Ondo State, Rt. Hon. Victor Olabimtan, reaffirmed the party’s unity, disclosing that the reconciliation committee established after the party congress had reached out to various party organs, interest groups and individuals. He said the committee had extended its engagements beyond the state, including visits to Abuja and Lagos, as part of efforts to bring aggrieved members back into the party’s fold. Olabimtan cited the participation of previously estranged leaders, including Wale Akinterinwa and Princess Oladunni Odu, at the recent presidential campaign rally in Ondo State as evidence that the reconciliation process was making progress. He said he had personally reached out to some party leaders, adding that Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa had also made the unification of different tendencies a priority since emerging as the party’s leader in the state. According to him, Tinubu’s emergence as the APC’s presidential candidate offered members an opportunity to put their differences aside and consolidate the party’s unity. “Nobody is left out. All we need to do is to ensure that we put more effort into strengthening the existing unity that we are all enjoying in the party today. “So, there is no cause for alarm. As we make progress, you will also see that our efforts, the efforts of the governor, the party and its leaders are indeed yielding fruits to ensure that everybody is brought on board,” he said. Olabimtan expressed confidence that the reconciliation efforts would translate into electoral victories for Tinubu, as well as the party’s candidates for the Senate, House of Representatives and state and national assemblies. Similarly, the Commissioner for Women Affairs, Dr. Seun Osamaye, pledged the support of women across the state for Tinubu’s re-election, saying unity and collective mobilisation would be crucial to achieving the party’s one-million-vote target. She said women in Ondo State were firmly behind the President and would mobilise support for his re-election. Osamaye attributed the anticipated support to what she described as interventions by the Federal Government and First Lady, Senator Oluremi Tinubu, in women’s economic empowerment, education, social inclusion and social protection for vulnerable groups. She disclosed that Ondo State had benefited from more than 20 interventions under the Renewed Hope initiatives. Among the programmes she listed were the distribution of 10,000 professional kits to nurses and healthcare assistants, the Nigerian Education Loan Fund (NELFUND), initiatives to promote youth participation in agribusiness and the Every Home Garden programme. She added that thousands of women had also benefited from economic empowerment programmes under the President’s Renewed Hope Initiative. “For the first time, government is not for the privileged few. Many women now benefit without having to beg or lobby,” she said. Osamaye expressed confidence that the interventions would translate into massive votes for Tinubu in the January 16, 2027 presidential election. She also dismissed suggestions of strained relations among party leaders, describing Princess Oladunni Odu, the state’s first female Secretary to the State Government, as a respected leader with whom she maintained a cordial relationship. Recalling their embrace at the recent presidential campaign rally, she insisted that both leaders were working together. The commissioner further described Governor Aiyedatiwa as the undisputed leader of the APC in Ondo State, enjoying the support of party members. Meanwhile, an APC chieftain, Chief Olusola Oke, dismissed concerns about political thuggery ahead of the 2027 general elections, maintaining that Ondo State remained peaceful and that no opposition member or party had been attacked by political thugs. Oke commended the state media for its vigilance and professionalism, particularly for broadening discussions beyond the presidential campaign rally to address the wider political situation in the country. He said reports of increasing political violence in other parts of Nigeria did not reflect the situation in Ondo State, arguing that the level of political support for Tinubu in the state left little basis for violence. While acknowledging reports of violence elsewhere, Oke attributed them to opposition to the President’s reforms and alleged that some individuals were seeking to undermine the electoral process out of concerns about their political relevance. He expressed confidence that security agencies would deal with anyone responsible for political thuggery and commended Aiyedatiwa, as the state’s Chief Security Officer, for maintaining security. Although acknowledging that disagreements and political tensions were inevitable in a diverse country like Nigeria, Oke maintained that isolated security incidents should not undermine the peaceful atmosphere needed for the 2027 elections. “At the end of the day, we are going to have the most peaceful election,” he said. Babatunde Kolawole表示有信心，该党将为总统Bola Tinubu及其他候选人赢得胜利，并强调正在进行的和解努力已取得积极成果。Kolawole在阿库雷接受记者采访时说，没有任何党员或利益群体被排除在加强全党团结、凝聚各方力量的努力之外。他说，党员没有理由把彼此视为竞争对手，尤其是在奥恩多州2027年不举行州长选举，而且Tinubu已成为该党唯一总统候选人的情况下。他说：“因此，不存在竞争，也没有什么值得警惕的。我可以向你们保证，我们完全能够掌控局面，一切都会好起来的。”Kolawole感谢Tinubu和APC全国主席的支持，同时赞扬参议院领袖Michael Opeyemi Bamidele参议员及其他党员为总统竞选取得成功所作的贡献。APC奥恩多州总统竞选总干事Rt. Hon. Victor Olabimtan也表示，该党保持团结，并透露党代会后成立的和解委员会已经联络各个党组织、利益群体和个人。他说，为争取意见不同的党员重新回归党的队伍，该委员会还把沟通工作扩大到州外，包括前往阿布贾和拉各斯。Olabimtan援引此前与党疏离的领导人参加奥恩多州近期总统竞选集会一事，称这是和解进程取得进展的证据，其中包括Wale Akinterinwa和Princess Oladunni Odu。他说，自己已亲自联络一些党的领导人，并补充称，州长Lucky Aiyedatiwa自从成为该党在州内的领导人以来，也把团结不同派别列为优先事项。据他表示，Tinubu成为APC总统候选人，让党员有机会搁置分歧、巩固党的团结。他说：“没有人被排除在外。我们需要做的只是确保更加努力地加强如今全党共同享有的团结。‘所以，没有什么值得警惕的。随着我们不断取得进展，你们也会看到，我们、州长、党及其领导人的努力确实正在结出果实，确保所有人都能参与其中。’”Olabimtan表示有信心，和解努力将转化为Tinubu以及该党参议院、众议院、州议会和全国议会候选人的选举胜利。同样，女性事务专员Dr. Seun Osamaye承诺支持全州女性支持Tinubu连任，并表示团结和集体动员对实现该党百万选票目标至关重要。她说，奥恩多州女性坚定支持总统，将动员支持他连任。Osamaye将预期中的支持归因于她所说的联邦政府和第一夫人、参议员Oluremi Tinubu在推动女性经济赋权、教育、社会融合以及保护弱势群体方面采取的干预措施。她透露，奥恩多州已从“更新希望”倡议下的20多项干预措施中受益。她列举的项目包括向护士和医疗辅助人员分发10,000套专业装备、尼日利亚教育贷款基金（NELFUND）、促进青年参与农业综合企业的举措，以及“家家花园”计划。她还补充说，总共有数千名女性从总统“更新希望倡议”下的经济赋权项目中受益。她说：“政府第一次不再只服务于少数特权者。如今许多女性无需乞求或游说，也能从中受益。”Osamaye表示有信心，这些干预措施将为Tinubu在2027年1月16日总统选举中赢得大量选票。她还驳斥了党内领导人关系紧张的说法，称该州首任女性州政府秘书Princess Oladunni Odu是一位受人尊敬的领导人，她与其保持着融洽关系。她回忆了两人在近期总统竞选集会上的拥抱，并坚称两位领导人正在携手合作。这位专员还称州长Aiyedatiwa是APC在奥恩多州无可争议的领导人，并得到党员支持。与此同时，APC元老Chief Olusola Oke驳斥了对2027年大选前发生政治暴力的担忧，称奥恩多州依然太平，没有任何反对党成员或政党遭到政治打手袭击。Oke赞扬州媒体保持警觉并秉持专业精神，尤其是将讨论从总统竞选集会延伸到全国更广泛的政治局势。他说，尼日利亚其他地区政治暴力事件增多的报道并不符合奥恩多州的实际情况，认为该州对Tinubu的政治支持程度使暴力几乎没有滋生的空间。Oke承认其他地方确有暴力报告，但将其归因于反对总统的改革，并称一些人担心自身政治影响力下降，因而试图破坏选举进程。他表示有信心安全机构会处理任何参与政治暴力的人，并赞扬Aiyedatiwa作为该州首席安全官维护了治安。尽管承认在尼日利亚这样多元的国家，分歧和政治紧张局势难以避免，Oke仍认为，孤立的安全事件不应破坏2027年选举所需的和平氛围。他说：“归根结底，我们将迎来一次最和平的选举。”此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点……

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: President Bola Tinubu has directed security agencies to crack down on political thuggery and other anti-democratic activities ahead of the 2027 general elections. He also warned politicians and their supporters against violence, saying his administration would not tolerate conduct capable of undermining public order during the electioneering period. Mr Tinubu gave the directive in a statement issued by the State House on Friday, following reports of violence accompanying political events in different parts of the country. Electoral violence has remained a recurring feature of Nigeria’s political landscape, with attacks, intimidation, clashes between rival supporters and destruction of campaign materials often accompanying electioneering activities. PREMIUM TIMES reports that recent incidents have heightened concerns. On 28 October, suspected political thugs attacked a convoy conveying All Progressives Congress (APC) supporters to a campaign rally in Funtua, Katsina State, injuring a woman and damaging vehicles. On 7 November, violence at a political procession in Asaba, Delta State, left one person dead and five others injured, according to the police. On 12 November, suspected thugs disrupted a Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) town hall meeting in Lagos, attacking supporters and damaging vehicles. Similar attacks were reported during political activities in other places including Ekiti, Cross River and Sokoto states. “Every form of violence stands condemned. Violence should never have a place in our political campaigns as we move toward the 2027 general elections,” Mr Tinubu said. He urged political parties to focus their campaigns on issues and competing ideas that promote the welfare of Nigerians and national development. “As the leader of this country, I commit myself to a peaceful, free, and fair election, and I urge political leaders and supporters across party lines to conduct themselves responsibly,” he said. Mr Tinubu said political differences and competing ambitions should not turn politicians into enemies, stressing that Nigerians belonged to the same national community. “I have said that being in different political parties or pursuing different ambitions does not make us enemies,” he said. The president also reiterated his earlier directive to security agencies to act firmly against anyone seeking to undermine public order. He said all political parties and candidates must be protected and allowed to campaign anywhere in the country without intimidation or threats to their safety. “Our administration is committed to an orderly and peaceful election, and all political parties and candidates should be protected and free to campaign anywhere in the country without molestation or fear for their safety,” he said. Mr Tinubu said security agencies had his authorisation to use full force against political thuggery and other activities threatening the electoral process. “Security agencies are therefore authorised to confront thuggery and other anti-social and anti-democratic activities with full force,” he added. PREMIUM TIMES reports that in response to incidents of violence, including the destruction of campaign materials in some parts of the country, the police issued a stern warning last week, saying that anyone found engaging in such acts would be arrested and prosecuted
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 2027年：Tinubu命令安全机构严厉打击政治暴徒行为
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 在2027年大选前夕，President Bola Tinubu已指示安全机构打击政治暴徒行为及其他反民主活动。他还警告政治人物及其支持者不得诉诸暴力，并表示政府绝不容忍任何可能破坏选举活动期间公共秩序的行为。Tinubu先生是在州府星期五发布的一份声明中作出上述指示的。此前有报道称，全国不同地区举行的政治活动伴随暴力事件。选举暴力一直是尼日利亚政治局势中反复出现的问题，竞选活动期间经常发生袭击、恐吓、竞争对手支持者之间的冲突以及竞选宣传材料被毁等情况。PREMIUM TIMES报道称，近期发生的事件加剧了人们的担忧。10月28日，疑似政治暴徒在卡塔ina州Funtua袭击了一支运送进步大会党（APC）支持者前往竞选集会的车队，造成一名妇女受伤和多辆汽车受损。据警方称，11月7日，Delta州Asaba一场政治游行发生暴力事件，造成1人死亡、5人受伤。11月12日，疑似暴徒在拉各斯扰乱尼日利亚民主大会党（NDC）的一场城镇会议，袭击支持者并损坏车辆。埃基蒂州、克罗斯河州和索科托州等地举行政治活动时也报告了类似袭击事件。Tinubu先生说：“一切形式的暴力行为都应受到谴责。随着我们迈向2027年大选，暴力行为绝不应出现在我们的政治竞选中。”他敦促各政党把竞选重点放在能够促进尼日利亚人民福祉和国家发展的议题及竞争性理念上。他说：“作为这个国家的领导人，我承诺推动一场和平、自由和公正的选举，并敦促各党派的政治领袖和支持者负责任地行事。”Tinubu先生说，政治分歧和不同的政治抱负不应使政治人物成为敌人，并强调尼日利亚人民同属一个国家共同体。他说：“我曾表示，身处不同政党或追求不同抱负并不意味着我们彼此为敌。”总统还重申了此前向安全机构发出的指示，要求其坚决打击任何企图破坏公共秩序的人。他说，所有政党和候选人都应受到保护，并获准在全国任何地方开展竞选，不受恐吓或人身安全威胁。他说：“本政府致力于实现有序、和平的选举，所有政党和候选人都应受到保护，并能在全国任何地方自由开展竞选，而不受骚扰或对人身安全的担忧。”Tinubu先生说，安全机构已获他的授权，可对政治暴徒行为及其他威胁选举进程的活动使用全部武力。他补充道：“因此，安全机构获授权以全部武力打击暴徒行为及其他反社会、反民主活动。”PREMIUM TIMES报道称，针对包括全国部分地区竞选宣传材料被毁在内的暴力事件，警方上周发出严厉警告，表示任何被发现从事此类行为的人都将被逮捕并依法起诉

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: The awards presented to Genesis Energy Holding on the opening day of the Summit, at the Landmark Event Centre, Lagos, on Tuesday, 10 November2026, under the theme, “Lagos Energy Evolution: Transforming the Future.” includes the “Most Impactful Project (Power) Award” and the “Excellence in Energy – Summit Partner Appreciation Award.” The first was conferred on the company by Hon Sabur Akanbi Oluwa, Chairman of the Lagos State House of Assembly Committee on Energy and Mineral Resources, while the second award was conferred on the company by Hon. Biodun Ogunleye, Commissioner for Energy and Mineral Resources, Lagos State. The recognition underscores Genesis Energy Holdings’commitment to advancing reliable electricity supply, developing critical power infrastructure and supporting the transformation of Lagos State’s energy sector through strategic investments and partnerships. Through its subsidiary, GELMAK Power Solutions Ltd, the company operates the Banana Island Local Grid Project in Ikoyi, Lagos, an integrated power generation and distribution network providing reliable electricity to residential and commercial customers. Designed to reduce dependence on expensive and polluting diesel and heavy fuel oil (HFO) generators, the project currently records approximately 99% uptime. Its infrastructure capacity was recently doubled from 15MVA to 30MVA following the commissioning of an expanded substation, strengthening its ability to meet the growing electricity demand within the community. Further demonstrating its commitment to expanding electricity infrastructure across Lagos State , GENESIS is developing Project Echo, the 260MW Ikorodu Power Project, in partnership with the Lagos State Government under the CLEM initiative. With the Lagos State Market Operator as off-taker, the gas-fired power project is designed to deliver reliable, grid-integrated electricity, strengthening power supply across Ikorodu and supporting the development of a more resilient electricity market. Once operational, the project is expected to improve electricity availability for households, businesses and industries, while stimulating economic activity and supporting the area’s continued development. Commenting on the awards, Chairman and CEO of Genesis Energy, Mr Akinwole II Omoboriowo, said: “We want to extend our gratitude to Lagos State for giving us the opportunity to serve. We are most grateful for this recognition, which, for us, is both an honour and a call to action – a call to invest more. The business of energy is a very serious affair. Without energy, there can be no life. For us at GENESIS, it is not just a business; it is a lifelong commitment to uplifting our country and our continent, with Lagos State being at the forefront of that commitment.” These investments reflect the Group’s alignment with Lagos State’s electricity sector reform agenda, particularly the objectives of the Lagos State Electricity Law 2024, which provides a framework for developing a competitive, transparent and commercially viable electricity market. Since its establishment in 2005, Genesis Energy Holdings has developed and financed clean energy projects across Africa, with operations and project footprints spanning 11 African countries. The company deploys a diverse range of technologies, including solar photovoltaic (PV), battery energy storage systems (BESS), natural gas, wind, hydro and hybrid solutions, to develop reliable and sustainable energy infrastructure for businesses, governments and communities. Its Nigerian portfolio includes the 84MW gas-fired power project at the Port Harcourt Refinery Complex, one of Nigeria’s largest licensed private off-grid power plants and NIDI project in Kano. In 2025, the Group further expanded its engagement in Nigeria through a US$500 million Memorandum of Understanding with the Katsina State Government for the development, financing, construction, operation and maintenance of major energy infrastructure projects across the State. With a vision to “Light Up Africa One Community at a Time,” GENESIS remains committed to developing and deploying reliable, affordable and sustainable energy infrastructure that addresses the continent’s growing energy needs. Through strategic investments, innovative technologies and partnerships with governments and private-sector stakeholders, the company continues to advance energy access, strengthen energy security and support economic development across Africa
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.title_zh: Genesis Energy 在拉各斯能源峰会上赢得两项奖项，进一步彰显其推动电力基础设施发展的承诺
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body_zh: 2026年11月10日星期二，在拉各斯Landmark Event Centre举行的峰会开幕当天，Genesis Energy Holding以“拉各斯能源演进：塑造未来”为主题获得“最具影响力项目（电力）奖”和“能源卓越奖——峰会合作伙伴致谢奖”。第一项奖由拉各斯州议会议会能源与矿产资源委员会主席Hon Sabur Akanbi Oluwa授予公司，第二项奖由拉各斯州能源与矿产资源专员Hon. Biodun Ogunleye授予公司。这一认可凸显了Genesis Energy Holdings致力于推进可靠电力供应、建设关键电力基础设施，并通过战略投资与合作推动拉各斯州能源部门转型的承诺。公司通过子公司GELMAK Power Solutions Ltd运营位于拉各斯Ikoyi的Banana Island Local Grid项目。该项目是一体化发电与配电网络，为住宅和商业客户提供可靠电力，旨在减少对昂贵且污染严重的柴油和重燃油（HFO）发电机的依赖，目前运行时间占比约为99%。扩建变电站投运后，其基础设施容量近期从15MVA增至30MVA，增强了满足社区不断增长的用电需求的能力。GENESIS还与拉各斯州政府合作，在CLEM倡议框架下开发Echo项目，即260MW的Ikorodu电力项目，以进一步扩大拉各斯州电力基础设施。项目由拉各斯州市场运营商作为购电方，这座燃气发电项目旨在输送可靠、并网运行的电力，加强Ikorodu的电力供应，并支持建设更具韧性的电力市场。项目投入运营后，预计将改善家庭、企业和工业用电的可用性，同时激发经济活动并支持当地持续发展。Genesis Energy董事长兼首席执行官Akinwole II Omoboriowo先生谈及获奖时表示：“我们要向拉各斯州给予我们服务机会表示由衷感谢。我们非常感谢这份认可，对我们而言，它既是一份荣誉，也是一项行动号召——呼吁我们加大投资。能源事业是一项非常严肃的事业。没有能源，就没有生活。对GENESIS而言，能源不仅是一门生意，更是一项毕生致力于提升我们国家和我们大陆福祉的承诺，而拉各斯州始终走在这一承诺的最前沿。”这些投资体现着集团与拉各斯州电力部门改革议程的一致性，特别是对《2024年拉各斯州电力法》目标的支持。该法为建设竞争、透明且具有商业可行性的电力市场提供了框架。自2005年成立以来，Genesis Energy Holdings已在非洲各地开发并资助清洁能源项目，业务及项目遍及11个非洲国家。公司采用多种技术，包括太阳能光伏（PV）、电池储能系统（BESS）、天然气、风能、水电和混合能源解决方案，为企业、政府和社区建设可靠、可持续的能源基础设施。其在尼日利亚的项目组合包括位于哈科特港炼油厂的84MW燃气发电项目——这是尼日利亚规模最大的持牌私营离网电站之一——以及位于卡诺的NIDI项目。2025年，集团通过与卡塔琳娜州政府签署价值US$500 million的谅解备忘录，进一步扩大在尼日利亚的业务合作，开发、融资、建设和运营维护该州的大型能源基础设施项目。秉持“逐个社区点亮非洲”的愿景，GENESIS继续致力于开发和部署可靠、可负担且可持续的能源基础设施，应对非洲大陆不断增长的能源需求。公司通过战略投资、创新技术以及与政府和私营部门相关方的合作，持续推进能源可及性、强化能源安全并支持非洲各地经济发展。

https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.body: DUBLIN — Friday's widespread outage of Microsoft products has sparked a new wave of calls for Europe to control its own digital infrastructure — especially with the uncertain future of artificial intelligence at stake. "Only 20% of European digital services run on European infrastructure," Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch said in remarks Friday after he addressed EU national leaders during their first-ever meeting on artificial intelligence in Dublin. The money spent on foreign, U.S. or Chinese, technology "could be reinvested here, on infrastructure we control and [to] finance European research and development," said the boss of Europe's leading AI frontier lab. Mensch didn't specifically address the Microsoft outage, which lasted nearly 24 hours and affected millions of users in 74 countries. Still, the shutdown of key tools like Outlook email and Teams messaging impacted plenty of the tech and government leaders gathered in Dublin to chart Europe’s AI future. French President Emmanuel Macron closed the day with a post on X : “Our independence cannot be outsourced. It must be built here at home, in Europe,” he wrote. "When it comes to artificial intelligence, too, Europe has everything it takes to compete. We have no time to lose.” Tech sovereignty, including control over the cloud, chips and models that power AI, has been a rallying cry of the second mandate of European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, and was one of the key agenda items at Friday's gathering of the leaders of the EU's 27 member countries. "We have outsourced too much of our digital infrastructure to actors outside the EU," Finnish European Parliament lawmaker Aura Salla said in a press release Friday following the outage. She suggested that government contracts specifically "must support European technology." Others zoned in on the risk created by relying on digital infrastructure controlled by a couple of large companies. The Microsoft outage is a "reminder of the systemic risk created by concentrating digital infrastructure with a few global tech giants," said Sebastian Toffaletti, secretary general of the Digital SME Alliance, in a statement shared with POLITICO. In Germany, lawmaker Johannes Schätzl from the Social Democratic Party said it raised questions about public procurement. “Digital sovereignty must be measured by whether we can remain operational even during outages like this,” he said
https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.title_zh: Microsoft 故障再次引发欧洲摆脱美国科技依赖的呼声
https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.body_zh: 都柏林——微软旗下产品周五发生大范围故障，再次引发要求欧洲掌控自身数字基础设施的呼声，尤其是在人工智能前景存在不确定性的背景下。Mistral首席执行官Arthur Mensch周五发表讲话称：“欧洲只有20%的数字服务运行在欧洲的基础设施上。”他此前在都柏林举行的首次欧盟各国领导人人工智能会议上发表了演讲。这家欧洲领先的前沿人工智能实验室负责人说，花在外国、美国或中国技术上的资金“可以在这里重新投资，用于我们掌控的基础设施，并资助欧洲的研究与开发”。Mensch没有直接评论微软故障。这次故障持续近24小时，影响了74个国家的数百万用户。不过，包括Outlook电子邮件和Teams即时通信在内的关键工具中断，还是影响了许多齐聚都柏林、筹划欧洲人工智能未来的科技和政府领导人。法国总统Emmanuel Macron在X上发帖为当天收尾：“我们的独立不能外包。必须在这里、在欧洲亲手建设。”他写道：“谈到人工智能，欧洲同样具备参与竞争的一切条件。我们没有时间可以浪费。”包括掌控云、芯片和人工智能模型在内的技术主权，一直是欧洲委员会主席Ursula von der Leyen第二任期的号召，也是周五欧盟27个成员国领导人会议的主要议程之一。芬兰籍欧洲议会议员Aura Salla在故障发生后于周五发布的新闻稿中说：“我们已将太多数字基础设施外包给欧盟之外的参与者。”她建议，政府合同必须明确“支持欧洲技术”。其他人则将焦点放在依赖少数几家公司掌控的数字基础设施所带来的风险上。Digital SME Alliance秘书长Sebastian Toffaletti在与POLITICO分享的一份声明中说，微软故障“提醒人们，将数字基础设施集中在少数全球科技巨头手中，会造成系统性风险”。德国社会民主党的议员Johannes Schätzl表示，此事引出了有关公共采购的问题。他说：“数字主权必须以我们能否在此类故障期间仍保持运行为衡量标准。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary_zh: 尼日利亚驻南非高级专员费米·法尼-卡约德已向南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨递交国书，正式开始在南非的外交任职。星期五，法尼-卡约德先生在比勒陀利亚的塞法科·马加托总统官邸——南非总统府官方驻地——向拉马福萨先生递交了国书。法尼-卡约德先生与来自其他14个国家的大使一同递交了国书。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: Nigeria’s High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, has presented his Letter of Credence to South African President Cyril Ramaphosa, marking the official commencement of his diplomatic assignment in the country. Mr Fani-Kayode presented his letter to Mr Ramaphosa at the Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guest House in Pretoria, the official residence of the South African Presidency, on Friday. The High Commissioner shared the development on X, describing the event as “great and historic.” Letters of credence are formal diplomatic documents issued by a country’s head of state to confirm the appointment of a High Commissioner or permanent representative. They officially introduce the envoy to the receiving authority, in this case, the South African president, and certify that the individual is empowered to speak and act on behalf of their nation. Mr Fani-Kayode presented his letter of credence alongside ambassadors from 14 other countries. Each was formally introduced and given the floor to speak. He pledged to strengthen diplomatic relations between both countries, describing the restoration of their historic friendship as a key priority of his diplomatic mission. The envoy, also accredited to Lesotho and Eswatini, conveyed President Bola Tinubu’s goodwill to Mr Ramaphosa. This comes amid tense relations between Nigeria and South Africa over xenophobic violence that forced many African states to evacuate their citizens residing in the country. Mr Fani-Kayode had previously condemned violence against Nigerian nationals by South African security officials. He estimated that at least 30 Nigerians have been killed by the state’s police in the last four years. 12 Nigerians have also been killed since the start of the year. In September, the High Commissioner said Nigeria’s patience was running thin. Speaking at the ceremony, however, Mr Fani-Kayode recalled Nigeria’s support for South Africa during the struggle against apartheid, saying both countries shared a longstanding history of solidarity and friendship. He described Nigeria and South Africa as major trading partners on the continent and stressed the importance of preserving their historical ties. “Part of my job here is to reset that relationship, to come and build that bridge, and to ensure that whatever concerns we have, we can work them out and move forward together,” he said. Mr Fani-Kayode added that closer cooperation between the two countries would strengthen Africa’s position and advance the interests of their citizens. “If Nigeria and South Africa work closely together, the destiny of our great continent will be more secure,” he said. The high commissioner also commended South Africa’s contributions to international diplomacy, particularly its role in BRICS, the Global South and the Group of 20 (G20). He described South Africa’s engagement in global affairs as important to strengthening Africa’s representation on the international stage. Meanwhile, Mr Fani-Kayode, on his X handle, complained that the South African presidential media team failed to live-stream his speech despite capturing those of the other ambassadors present. “Of all the 15 introductions and speeches that were made and delivered this morning, only Nigeria’s was cut out,” he said. “To be clear, I repeat, we were the ONLY ones that were left out.” “Clearly, some elements in South Africa do not want to hear what we have to say or see our faces, but we are here to stay as long as we are welcome and have the confidence of President Ramaphosa, which I am sure we do,” he noted further
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title_zh: 法尼-卡约德向拉马福萨递交国书，正式履任大使
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh: 尼日利亚驻南非大使费米·法尼-卡约德向南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨递交国书，正式开始其在南非的外交任期。法尼-卡约德先生于星期五在比勒陀利亚的塞法科·马卡托总统迎宾馆——南非总统府官方官邸——向拉马福萨先生递交国书。大使在X平台分享了这一消息，称此次活动“重大而具有历史意义”。国书是由一国国家元首签发的正式外交文件，用于确认任命高级专员或常驻代表。国书向接受国主管机构正式介绍特使，本例中的接受国主管机构是南非总统，并证明该人士获授权代表本国发表言论和采取行动。法尼-卡约德先生与其他14个国家的大使一同递交国书。每位大使均获正式介绍，并获发言机会。他承诺加强两国外交关系，并将恢复两国历史友谊列为其外交使命的一项重点。该特使同时获派驻莱索托和斯威士兰，并向拉马福萨先生转达了博拉·蒂努布总统的友好问候。此前，尼日利亚与南非因针对外国人的暴力袭击而关系紧张，许多非洲国家被迫撤离居住在南非的本国公民。法尼-卡约德先生此前曾谴责南非安全官员针对尼日利亚公民的暴力行为。他估计，过去四年间，该国警察已造成至少30名尼日利亚人死亡。今年年初以来，又有12名尼日利亚人死亡。9月，大使表示尼日利亚的耐心已接近极限。不过，法尼-卡约德先生在仪式上回顾了尼日利亚在南非反抗种族隔离斗争期间对南非的支持，称两国共享源远流长的团结与友谊历史。他将尼日利亚和南非描述为非洲大陆的重要贸易伙伴，并强调维护两国历史联系的重要性。他说：“我在这里承担的工作之一，就是重置双方关系，前来搭建这座桥梁，并确保无论双方有何关切，都能共同解决分歧，携手向前。”法尼-卡约德先生补充说，两国加强合作将增强非洲的立场，并促进两国公民的利益。他说：“如果尼日利亚和南非紧密合作，我们这个伟大大陆的未来将更加稳固。”大使还赞扬南非对国际外交的贡献，尤其是南非在金砖国家、全球南方和二十国集团（G20）中的作用。他表示，南非参与全球事务对于加强非洲在国际舞台上的代表性至关重要。与此同时，法尼-卡约德先生在其X账号上抱怨，尽管南非总统媒体团队拍摄了其他在场大使的演讲，却未对本国演讲进行直播。他说：“今天上午进行的15次介绍和发言中，唯独尼日利亚的发言被剪掉了。”“明确地说，我再重复一遍，我们是唯一被排除在外的。”他进一步指出：“显然，南非某些人士不希望听到我们要说的话，也不希望看到我们的面孔；但只要我们受到欢迎，并得到拉马福萨总统的信任，我们就会留在这里。我确信我们确实得到了他的信任。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The US government is doubling down on its immigration control, with the State Department revoking over 6,000 visas belonging to foreigners engaged in or facilitating birth tourism. The department announced on Thursday, through its X handle, that its Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force had revoked the visas of people identified as involved in the practice. “The Department of State’s Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force has now revoked more than 6,000 visas from foreigners who engaged in or facilitated birth tourism,” the post read. It also said the task force is still identifying and “holding accountable everyone involved in this illicit practice.” This implies that more visas are likely to be revoked over this practice in the future. Birth tourism refers to travelling to another country, usually while pregnant, to give birth so the child can acquire that country’s citizenship or nationality by birth. The latest action signals a wider crackdown on both participants and facilitators, including those who help arrange such travel. Last month, the department announced that it had revoked over 4,000 visas, and that 700 of the revoked visas belonged to Chinese nationals. The latest statement, however, did not provide a breakdown by nationality. As such, it remains unclear whether Nigerians were among those affected. A core aspect of President Donald Trump’s “America first” policy and political campaigns has been a crackdown on immigration. The US leader, during his presidential campaigns, pledged to increase deportations of people living in the country, restrict asylum and refugee admissions, and tighten both illegal and some legal immigration pathways. Since resuming office, Mr Trump has implemented several policies aligned with this agenda. At the inauguration ceremony, for instance, he signed an executive order declaring illegal immigration a national emergency and ordered the speedy deportation of undocumented migrants. The United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement crackdown on migrants has, in the past year, been criticised for human rights violations. The Trump administration also imposed visa bans on several countries, including Nigeria. It is also planning to introduce a policy requiring foreign nationals in the US seeking to change their status from temporary visa holders to permanent residents to return to their home country to apply for a Green Card

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 美国政府正在加强移民管控。美国国务院吊销了6,000多张签证，持证人均为参与或协助“生育旅游”的外国人。该部门周四通过其X账号宣布，其“生育旅游防范特遣队”已吊销被认定参与这一行为者的签证。帖文称：“美国国务院生育旅游防范特遣队现已吊销6,000多张签证，涉及参与或协助生育旅游的外国人。”帖文还表示，特遣队仍在查明并“追究所有参与这一非法行为者的责任”。这意味着，未来可能还会因这一行为吊销更多签证。生育旅游是指前往另一个国家，通常在怀孕期间前往当地生产，使孩子通过出生取得该国国籍或身份。最新行动表明，美国正在更广泛地打击参与者和协助者，包括帮助安排此类旅行的人。上个月，该部门宣布已吊销4,000多张签证，其中700张被吊销的签证属于中国公民。不过，最新声明没有提供按国籍划分的明细。因此，目前尚不清楚尼日利亚公民是否在受影响的签证持有人之列。严厉打击移民一直是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普“美国优先”政策和政治竞选的核心内容之一。美国领导人在竞选期间承诺增加对居住在美国的外国人的驱逐力度，限制庇护和难民接收，并收紧非法移民以及部分合法移民通道。特朗普复任以来，已实施多项符合这一议程的政策。例如，在就职典礼上，他签署行政命令，将非法移民宣布为全国紧急状态，并下令迅速遣返无证移民。过去一年，美国移民与海关执法局针对移民的执法行动因侵犯人权而受到批评。特朗普政府还对包括尼日利亚在内的多个国家实施签证禁令。该政府还计划推出新政策，要求在美国希望从临时签证持有人身份转为永久居民的外籍人士返回其原籍国申请绿卡

Unlock these with Subscription The fifth round of the India-Bangladesh consular dialogue will be held on a “mutually convenient date”, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said on Friday (November 13). Speaking to the media during the bi-weekly media briefing, Randhir Jaiswal, Official Spokesperson of the MEA, reiterated that India seeks to build “positive, constructive and forward-looking” relations with Bangladesh. “The next round of the India-Bangladesh Consular Dialogue, which will also take up matters relating to the Revised Travel Arrangement, will be held on a mutually convenient date. India remains ready to discuss all bilateral issues with Bangladesh through these existing mechanisms, including at the technical level,” Mr. Jaiswal said. The Hindu had reported on Thursday (November 12) about the postponement of the consular talks that were to be held on November 17 and 18. “India desires a positive, constructive, and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh. Accordingly, initiatives have been taken and meetings held under our structured mechanisms in such areas as trade, railways, water resources, and border management, among others,” said Mr. Jaiswal. Diplomatic sources had indicated that the postponement was because of the spike in tensions in view of the proposed return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh. Ms. Hasina has been in India since August 5, 2024 and she has said that she would return to Dhaka in December. The two sides started consular dialogue in 2017 to strengthen people-to-people contact by having a regular channel of communication on consular, visa, and mutual legal assistance cooperation matters. Four rounds of consular dialogue were held during the rule of the Awami League in Dhaka. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周五在会见中国外交部长王毅时表示，朝鲜半岛和平符合韩国和中国的共同利益，并呼吁加强双边沟通，推动半岛局势发展。赵显在开场发言中说：“朝鲜半岛问题事关韩国的重大利益，半岛的和平与稳定符合两国共同利益。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun said Friday that peace on the Korean Peninsula serves the shared interests of South Korea and China during a meeting with his Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, calling for stronger bilateral communication to advance the situation on the peninsula. The ministerial talks took place in Beijing ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen next week, where President Lee Jae Myung and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to meet. "The Korean Peninsula issue is a vital interest for South Korea, and peace and stability on the peninsula serve the shared interests of both countries," Cho said in his opening remarks. "I hope the two countries will continue to strengthen strategic communication to make progress on the situation on the Korean Peninsula," he added, expressing hope that a meeting between the two leaders in Shenzhen would provide an opportunity to further develop their strategic cooperative partnership. Wang said bilateral relations had returned to a normal track following the leaders' reciprocal visits last year and early this year, stressing the need to maintain high-level exchanges and further develop their strategic partnership. Noting that bilateral trade is expected to reach a record high this year, he expressed hope that people-to-people exchanges would recover to around 10 million annually. With the two countries hosting the APEC summit consecutively, Wang called for joint efforts to promote regional development and prosperity, expressing hope that the upcoming summit would give fresh momentum to bilateral ties. South Korea hosted last year's APEC summit in the southeastern city of Gyeongju. At that time, the two ministers exchanged views on bilateral relations and Korean Peninsula issues, with Cho calling for Beijing to play a constructive role in bringing North Korea back to dialogue. Before departing for Beijing for a two-day visit earlier in the day, Cho said he and Xi planned to discuss issues that need to be coordinated ahead of the APEC summit, as well as North Korea-related matters, including the possibility of U.S.-North Korea talks. Other issues on the agenda include pending bilateral matters, such as ways to enhance economic and cultural exchanges and cooperation, as well as Chinese structures installed in the Yellow Sea. The talks come amid deepening ties between China and North Korea, following Xi's visit to Pyongyang in June and a series of high-level exchanges between the two countries. Wang accompanied Xi during his visit to the United States in August. He was also present during Kim's surprise visit to the Chinese border city of Dandong last month. Inter-Korean relations, however, remain frozen. Pyongyang defines ties with Seoul as those between two hostile states and has rejected the Lee Jae Myung administration's calls for dialogue. There has been speculation about a possible meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during Trump's trip to Asia for the APEC summit, as the U.S. president has expressed interest in resuming dialogue with Pyongyang. Asked whether he believes China is willing to mediate between Washington and Pyongyang, Cho expressed uncertainty over how actively Beijing might pursue such efforts. "I don't think there is much chance of China actively inviting (Kim) to the APEC summit for talks, but it is still too early to tell," the minister said. A South Korean presidential official said Thursday that a meeting between Trump and Kim on the sidelines of the APEC summit was unlikely, while noting that it was difficult to predict whether contact between the two leaders might take place before or after the summit
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 赵兑烈在会见王毅期间表示，朝半岛和平符合韩国与中国的共同利益
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周五在会见中国 counterparts 王毅时表示，朝鲜半岛的和平符合韩国和中国的共同利益，并呼吁加强双边沟通，推动半岛局势发展。这场部长级会谈在北京举行，先于下周在深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会；韩国总统李在明和中国国家主席习近平预计将在峰会上会晤。赵显在开场发言中说：“朝鲜半岛问题是韩国的核心利益，半岛的和平稳定符合两国共同利益。我希望两国继续加强战略沟通，推动朝鲜半岛局势取得进展。”他还表示，希望两国领导人在深圳会晤能为进一步发展战略合作伙伴关系提供机会。王毅表示，在两国领导人去年及今年年初相互访问后，双边关系已回到正常轨道，并强调需要保持高层交往，进一步发展战略伙伴关系。他指出，预计今年双边贸易额将创历史新高，并希望民间交往恢复到每年约1000人次的水平。鉴于两国将连续主办APEC峰会，王毅呼吁共同努力，促进区域发展与繁荣，并希望即将举行的峰会为双边关系注入新的动力。韩国去年在东南部城市庆州主办了APEC峰会。当时，两国外长就双边关系和朝鲜半岛问题交换了意见，赵显呼吁北京在促使朝鲜重返对话方面发挥建设性作用。当天早些时候，在启程前往北京进行为期两天的访问之前，赵显表示，他与习近平计划讨论APEC峰会前需要协调的议题以及与朝鲜有关的事务，包括举行美朝会谈的可能性。议程中的其他议题还包括尚未解决的双边事务，例如加强经济文化交流与合作的办法，以及黄海上的中国设施。会谈是在中国与朝鲜关系日益密切的背景下举行的。此前，习近平于6月访问平壤，两国之间进行了一系列高层交往。8月习近平访问美国时，王毅陪同出访。上个月，朝鲜最高领导人金正恩突然访问中国边境城市丹东时，王毅也在场。然而，朝韩关系仍陷于僵局。平壤将首尔关系定义为两个敌对国家之间的关系，并拒绝李在明政府提出的对话倡议。随着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普赴亚洲出席APEC峰会，外界一直在猜测特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩可能会晤，因为这位美国总统已表示有兴趣恢复与平壤的对话。当被问及是否认为中国愿意在华盛顿与平壤之间进行调解时，赵显对北京会多积极地推进相关努力表示不确定。这位部长说：“我认为中国主动邀请（金正恩）参加APEC峰会会谈的可能性不大，但现在下结论还为时过早。”一名韩国总统府官员周四表示，特朗普与金正恩在APEC峰会期间会面的可能性不大，同时指出，难以预测两位领导人是否会在峰会前或峰会后进行接触

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary_zh: 韩国产业部表示，在国际油价高企和中东地区持续紧张局势的背景下，韩国政府周五连续第五个周期维持燃油产品最高限价不变。自6月26日下调后，政府已将最高限价维持在当前水平20周。政府于3月中旬推出燃油最高限价，旨在稳定因美伊战争在中东引发的供应链中断而出现波动的国内燃油价格。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: The Korean government on Friday kept its price caps on fuel products unchanged for a fifth consecutive period amid elevated international oil prices and continued tensions in the Middle East, the industry ministry said. The maximum prices at which local refiners can supply gasoline, diesel and kerosene to gas stations will remain unchanged at 1,784 won ($1.3), 1,773 won and 1,380 won per liter, respectively, for the four weeks beginning Saturday, according to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources. The government has kept the caps at their current levels for 20 weeks since June 27, following a reduction on June 26. "International oil prices fell below $100 per barrel, with Brent crude reaching $96 per barrel on Nov. 12. However, the price remains more than $20 higher than at the end of June," the ministry said. The freeze is aimed at easing upward pressure on consumer prices amid elevated oil prices and high ocean freight costs, it added. The government introduced the fuel price caps in mid-March to stabilize domestic fuel prices amid supply chain disruptions stemming from the U.S.-Iran war in the Middle East. It plans to adjust the emergency measures as necessary while closely monitoring developments in the Middle East and economic conditions at home

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary: Former official drops chamber folk album adapting classic sonnets Yong Ho-seong, former vice minister of culture, sports and tourism, is stepping into a bold new chapter of his creative life by using artificial intelligence (AI) technology to set classical literature to music. 10, breathing contemporary musical life into 15 of William Shakespeare's sonnets through AI-assisted composition and vocals.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 前官员推出商会民谣专辑，改编经典十四行诗。前文化、体育和旅游副部长 Yong Ho-seong 正利用人工智能（AI）技术为古典文学谱曲，开启艺术生涯大胆崭新的篇章。他借助 AI 辅助作曲和演唱，为威廉·莎士比亚的15首十四行诗注入当代音乐生命力，共推出10张唱片。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Former official drops chamber folk album adapting classic sonnets Yong Ho-seong, former vice minister of culture, sports and tourism, is stepping into a bold new chapter of his creative life by using artificial intelligence (AI) technology to set classical literature to music. Performing under the stage name Dr. Dragon, Yong released his debut full-length album, "Fragile Beauty," on Nov. 10, breathing contemporary musical life into 15 of William Shakespeare's sonnets through AI-assisted composition and vocals. The release marks the first installment of "DiVerse," an ambitious ongoing project to set all 154 of Shakespeare's sonnets to modern music. The idea was sparked by a hardcover edition of Shakespeare's complete sonnets that a British friend gifted him during his tenure as director of the Korean Cultural Centre UK. "The name reflects both Shakespeare's original verse and the newly written lyrics, as well as the diverse musical genres used to reimagine centuries-old classics," Yong told The Korea Times during an interview in Seoul, Thursday. The former vice minister explained that the album's sound production leans into late-1960s avant-garde folk and chamber folk, driven by nylon-string guitars, upright contrabass, cellos, violas, flutes, harmoniums and bass clarinets, while featuring the contralto tones of his AI vocal persona NikkiD. "Rather than big, sweeping arrangements, the quiet, intimate sound of late-1960s chamber folk felt like the right fit for these poems," Yong said. Yong’s journey into music creation is rooted in a lifelong passion. Long before entering government service, he studied classical music and jazz extensively and built a massive personal collection of over 10,000 records. While serving as a government official, he also debuted as a music critic in 1993 after winning an annual music criticism competition hosted by the prominent performing arts magazine Auditorium. He has also spent decades playing drums in jazz and rock bands. After retiring from his career as a high-ranking bureaucrat last year — during which he played a pivotal role in establishing major cultural institutions and drafting key legislation — Yong turned his sights toward AI. In July, he won the AI.LOVE.JAZZ. composition competition in Montreux, Switzerland, with "Frozen Edge," a vocal jazz piece inspired by Shakespeare's Sonnet 97. For Yong, AI is not a replacement for human artistry, but an essential creative tool. "AI is a loyal assistant that expands the possibilities of songwriting and production," the creator said. "I write detailed prompts spanning a full page to specify rhythm, instrumentation and musical references, and sometimes regenerate a track 30 or 40 times before editing individual tracks myself until I find the exact sound I envision." Comparing AI to the historical introduction of digital sampling in popular music decades ago in the 1980s, the former official believes that technology ultimately broadens the base of music creators rather than diminishing human value. Rather than requiring years of formal composition training, individuals with a clear artistic perspective can now use these tools to bring their musical concepts to life, he added. "Just like sampling decades ago, AI acts as a faithful assistant that expands the pool of people who can create music, making the process far more efficient for everyone," Yong said. Looking ahead, he envisions how this collaborative approach could even transform traditional education by allowing students to turn personal stories and daily emotions into original songs. "When students learn to turn their daily experiences into melodies, music becomes a powerful tool for self-expression," Yong said. Following the release of "Fragile Beauty," Yong plans to issue a new sonnet-inspired album every month, spanning genres from jazz and blues to hip-hop, rap-metal and K-pop. He has already reached out to various Shakespeare-related societies, associations and academic institutions around the world to explore educational and cultural collaborations. He is also developing progressive rock operas based on Shakespeare's tragedies, such as "Hamlet" and "Macbeth," alongside a project reinterpreting the poetry of Joseon Dynasty poet Yi Mae-chang (1573-1610). "Just as I am reimagining Shakespeare, I wanted to bring the poignant and soul-searching poetry of Yi Mae-chang into contemporary folk and blues," Yong said. While the former vice minister devotes up to six hours a day to composing and two hours of practicing drums, Yong said his creative ventures are fueled by personal fulfillment rather than commercial success. He recently earned his first-ever revenue as a musician by composing a theme song for T&C Foundation, a public interest foundation, though the ex-official primarily views his creative output as a natural extension of a well-prepared second act in life. "For me, happiness is not about the high intensity of achievements, but the frequency of joyful moments," Yong said. "Whether it is practicing drums in the morning or giving classical literature a new voice through modern music, I am simply enjoying a life where I can freely explore what I love."

前官员发行室内民谣专辑，以人工智能改编古典十四行诗
前文化、体育和旅游部副部长龙浩成正以人工智能（AI）技术为古典文学谱曲，开启创意人生的大胆新篇章。他以艺名“Dragon博士”演出，11月10日发行首张完整专辑《脆弱之美》，通过人工智能辅助作曲和人声演绎，为威廉·莎士比亚的15首十四行诗注入当代音乐生命力。这次发行是“DiVerse”计划的第一部分；该雄心勃勃的持续项目旨在将莎士比亚全部154首十四行诗谱成现代音乐。这一构想源于一位英国朋友在他担任韩国文化中心英国主任期间送给他的《莎士比亚十四行诗全集》精装版。龙浩成周四在首尔接受《韩国时报》采访时表示：“这个名字既反映莎士比亚的原诗，也体现新创作的歌词，以及重新演绎百年经典时采用的多样音乐类型。”这位前副部长介绍，专辑的声音制作以20世纪60年代末的前卫民谣和室内民谣为主，由尼龙弦吉他、立式低音提琴、大提琴、中提琴、长笛、风琴和低音单簧管支撑，并展现其人工智能人声形象NikkiD的女中音音色。龙浩成说：“与宏大、层层铺陈的编曲相比，20世纪60年代末室内民谣安静而亲密的声音，更适合这些诗。”
龙浩成投身音乐创作，源于一生的热爱。早在进入政府部门之前，他就广泛学习古典音乐和爵士乐，并收藏了1万多张唱片。担任政府官员期间，他还在1993年赢得知名表演艺术杂志《Auditorium》主办的一年一度音乐评论比赛，首次以乐评人身份登台。他还花了数十年时间在爵士和摇滚乐队中担任鼓手。去年从高级官僚职位退休——任职期间，他在建立重要文化机构和起草关键立法方面发挥了关键作用——后，龙浩成将目光转向人工智能。今年7月，他凭借受莎士比亚第97首十四行诗启发创作的声乐爵士作品《冰冻边缘》，在瑞士蒙特勒赢得AI.LOVE.JAZZ.作曲比赛。这位创作者表示，对龙浩成而言，人工智能不是人类艺术创作的替代品，而是一种不可或缺的创作工具。他说：“人工智能是一名忠实的助手，扩大了歌曲创作和制作的可能性。我会写满整整一页的详细提示词，规定节奏、乐器配置和音乐参考，有时还会将一首曲子重新生成30或40次，再亲自编辑各个音轨，直到找到自己设想的确切声音。”
这位前官员将人工智能与20世纪80年代数字采样技术首次引入流行音乐作比较，认为技术最终拓宽了音乐创作者的群体，而非削弱人的价值。他补充说，人们不必再经过多年的正规作曲训练，只要拥有清晰的艺术视角，如今就能利用这些工具让音乐构想成为现实。龙浩成说：“就像几十年前的采样一样，人工智能是一名忠实的助手，扩大了能够创作音乐的人群，让每个人的创作过程都高效得多。”
展望未来，他设想这种协作方式甚至可以改变传统教育，让学生能够将个人故事和日常感受转化为原创歌曲。龙浩成说：“当学生学会把日常经历化为旋律时，音乐就成为自我表达的强大工具。”继《脆弱之美》发行后，龙浩成计划每月推出一张受十四行诗启发的专辑，涵盖爵士、布鲁斯、嘻哈、说唱金属和K-pop等多种风格。他还联系了世界各地与莎士比亚有关的社团、协会和学术机构，探讨教育与文化合作。他也在根据莎士比亚的悲剧创作前卫摇滚歌剧，如《哈姆雷特》和《麦克白》，同时推进一个重新诠释朝鲜王朝诗人李梅昌（1573—1610）诗歌的项目。龙浩成说：“就像我重新演绎莎士比亚一样，我也希望把李梅昌那些动人、直击灵魂的诗歌带入当代民谣和布鲁斯。”
这位前副部长每天最多投入六小时作曲，并花两小时练习鼓乐。龙浩成说，他的创作动力来自个人满足感，而非商业成功。他最近通过为公益基金会T&C Foundation创作主题曲，首次获得音乐人生的第一笔收入；但这位前官员主要把自己的创作成果视为充分准备的人生第二幕的自然延伸。龙浩成说：“对我来说，快乐不在于成就的高强度，而在于欢乐时刻的频率。无论是清晨练鼓，还是通过现代音乐为古典文学赋予新声，我只是在享受一种能够自由探索所爱之物的生活。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 韩国政府周五表示，Google已经遵守相关安全要求；这些要求是获准向海外传输高精度地图数据的附加条件。国土交通部表示，政府牵头的咨询机构审查了Google落实安全措施的情况。该机构曾于2月有条件批准Google出口比例尺为1:5000的数字地图数据。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: The Korean government said Friday that Google has complied with security requirements imposed as a condition for allowing the transfer of high-precision map data overseas. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said a government-led consultation body reviewed Google's implementation of security measures following its conditional approval in February to export 1:5,000-scale digital map data. The review found that the global tech giant had implemented measures to prevent the exposure of geographic coordinates, as well as sensitive military and security facilities, on its global Google Maps and Google Earth services, including web and mobile platforms. To meet the requirements, Google developed a dedicated control system for Korea and introduced safeguards to block app updates if they risk exposing restricted geographic coordinates. In August, Google also signed an agreement to obtain satellite imagery processed for security purposes by the National Geographic Information Institute (NGII) through a local partner. Google is said to have chosen the local navigation company, TMAP Mobility, to process base map data, according to industry sources. Under the agreement, Google must replace existing imagery on its map services as soon as it receives the security-processed images, without making any modifications. Currently, Naver Map, operated by the local portal giant Naver Corp., is the most widely used service in the country, with monthly active users of 31.2 million in October, according to data from market tracker Mobile Index. TMAP came next with 15.1 monthly active users, followed by Kakao Map with 13.8 million users and Google Map with 10.5 million users locally
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 韩国政府：Google遵守韩国对高精度地图数据的安全要求
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 韩国政府周五表示，Google 已遵守相关安全要求；这些要求是允许其向海外传输高精度地图数据的附加条件。国土交通部表示，政府牵头的咨询机构审查了 Google 在2月获准出口比例尺为1:5,000的数字地图数据后所采取安全措施的落实情况。审查发现，这家全球科技巨头已在旗下 Google Maps 和 Google Earth 服务（包括网页端和移动端）实施相关措施，防止泄露地理坐标以及敏感的军事和安全设施。为满足有关要求，Google 为韩国开发了一套专用控制系统，并设置安全防护机制，在应用更新可能暴露受限地理坐标时予以阻止。今年8月，Google 还签署了一项协议，将通过一家本地合作伙伴获取由国家地理信息院（NGII）出于安全目的处理的卫星图像。据行业消息人士称，Google 选择了本地导航企业 TMAP Mobility 处理基础地图数据。根据该协议，Google 在收到经过安全处理的图像后，必须立即替换其地图服务中的现有图像，且不得作任何修改。据市场追踪机构 Mobile Index 的数据，目前由本地门户网站巨头 Naver Corp. 运营的 Naver Map 是韩国使用最广泛的服务，10月月活跃用户达到3120万。TMAP 以1510万月活跃用户紧随其后，Kakao Map 和 Google Map 在当地的月活跃用户分别为1380万和1050万

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.summary: (베이징·서울=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 김지헌 기자 = 조현 외교부 장관이 13일 한반도 문제와 관련한 중국의 건설적 역할을 당부했다. 왕이 중국 외교부장은 중국의 한반도 정책에는 변함이 없다면서 한반도 평화·안정을 위한 건설적 역할을 지속해 나갈 것임을 재확인했다. 외교부는 두 장관이 이날 오후 중국 베이징 댜오위타이(釣魚臺) 국빈관에서 3시간에 걸쳐 외교장관회담과 만찬을 갖고 한중 관계와 한반도 문제 등 상호 관심사에 대해 의견을 교환했다고 밝혔다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.summary_zh: （北京、首尔=韩联社）韩中首席特派记者金智宪报道：外交部长赵显13日就朝鲜半岛问题呼吁中国发挥建设性作用。中国外交部长王毅表示，中国对朝鲜半岛的政策没有改变，并将继续为朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定发挥建设性作用。外交部表示，两位外交部长当天下午在北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行会谈并共进晚餐，双方就韩中关系、朝鲜半岛问题等共同关心的事项交换了意见，会谈持续3小时。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.body: (베이징·서울=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 김지헌 기자 = 조현 외교부 장관이 13일 한반도 문제와 관련한 중국의 건설적 역할을 당부했다. 왕이 중국 외교부장은 중국의 한반도 정책에는 변함이 없다면서 한반도 평화·안정을 위한 건설적 역할을 지속해 나갈 것임을 재확인했다. 외교부는 두 장관이 이날 오후 중국 베이징 댜오위타이(釣魚臺) 국빈관에서 3시간에 걸쳐 외교장관회담과 만찬을 갖고 한중 관계와 한반도 문제 등 상호 관심사에 대해 의견을 교환했다고 밝혔다. 조 장관은 한반도의 평화·안정이 한중 양국의 공동 이익임을 강조했고 한반도 비핵화와 평화 실현을 위한 정부의 노력을 설명했으며 북한의 대화 복귀 등 한반도 문제에서 중국의 역할을 당부했다. 왕 부장은 이에 대해 답하면서 '비핵화' 표현을 명시적으로 쓰지 않는 최근의 태도를 이어갔지만, 비핵화가 포함되는 기존의 중국 대한반도 정책에 변함이 없다는 입장을 반복했다. 왕 부장은 지난 8월 서울에서 조 장관과 외교장관회담을 벌였을 때도 '한반도 문제에 대한 중국의 입장은 연속적이고 안정적'이라는 취지로 언급한 바 있다. 회담에서 조 장관은 정부가 작년 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 의장국으로서 내주 개최되는 선전 APEC 정상회의의 성공적 개최를 기원한다고 했다. 이어 선전에서 양국 정상 간 교류가 한중 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 더욱 성숙하게 발전시키는 중요한 계기가 될 수 있도록 잘 준비해 나가자고 했다. 왕 부장은 한중 관계의 긍정적 흐름이 작년 경주에서 선전으로 이어지고 있음을 평가하면서 이재명 대통령의 선전 APEC 계기 방중을 환영하며 충분한 예우를 갖춰 이번 방문이 성공적으로 이루어질 수 있도록 하겠다고 화답했다. 양 장관은 작년과 올해 양국 정상의 상호 국빈방문을 통한 한중관계 전면 복원의 흐름이 구체 성과로 나타나고 있음을 평가하고, 내년 수교 35주년을 맞아 양국 국민이 체감할 수 있는 실질적인 성과를 지속 창출해 나가기 위한 여러 방안에 대해 논의했다. 특히 한중 자유무역협정(FTA) 서비스·투자 협상 진전을 통해 양국의 수평적·호혜적 경제협력의 기반을 강화해 나가는 한편 양 국민 간 인적교류를 확대하고 우호정서를 증진하기 위한 노력도 강화해 나가자는 데도 의견을 같이 했다. 조 장관은 서해 문제 등 사안에서 한국의 원칙적 입장을 전달했으며 중국 내 한국 국민의 안전과 권익 보호를 위한 중국 정부의 노력도 당부했다. 이와 관련해 양 장관은 이런 사안들이 양국 관계 발전에 걸림돌이 되지 않도록 세심하게 관리해 나가자는 데 공감했다고 외교부가 전했다. 회담의 본격적 시작에 앞서 조 장관은 모두발언을 통해 "한반도 문제는 대한민국의 사활적 이익이며 한반도 평화와 안정은 양국의 공동이익"이라며 "한반도 정세 진전을 위해 양국 간 전략적 소통을 계속 강화해 나가기를 기대한다"고 말했다. 이어 "다음 주 선전에서 양국 정상이 10개월 만에 다시 만나 한중 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 더욱 성숙하게 발전시켜 나가는 중요한 계기를 만들 것으로 기대한다"며 "경주에서 시작된 두 정상 간 우정과 신뢰의 이야기가 베이징을 거쳐 선전으로 이어지면서 한중 관계도 더욱 돈독해지기를 희망한다"고 말했다. 조 장관은 지난해 11월과 올해 1월 양국 정상의 상호 국빈 방문 이후 한중 관계가 전면 복원의 흐름을 공고히 해왔다고 평가했다. 그러면서 "올해 한중 인적 교류는 1천만명을 돌파할 것으로 예상된다"며 "한중 간 교역도 40% 넘게 증가했다"고 말했다. 이어 "이는 양국 정상 간 전면적 관계 복원에 대한 공동 인식을 이행하기 위해 양국 정부가 긴밀히 소통하며 함께 노력해온 결과"라고 강조했다. 조 장관은 이번 회담을 통해 다음 주 양국 정상의 만남이 성공적으로 이뤄질 수 있도록 협의하기를 기대한다고 덧붙였다. 왕 부장은 모두발언에서 "지난해 말과 올해 초 시진핑 국가주석과 이재명 대통령의 성공적인 상호 방문으로 중한 관계가 개선과 발전의 정상 궤도로 돌아왔다"고 평가했다. 이어 "다음 단계의 고위급 접촉을 준비하는 것이 매우 필요하다"며 "내년 중한 수교 35주년을 계기로 양국이 함께 노력해 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 올바른 궤도로 발전시켜 나가야 한다"고 강조했다. 왕 부장은 올해 양국 교역액이 사상 최고치를 기록할 것으로 전망하면서 인적 왕래도 연간 1천만명 수준을 회복할 것으로 기대했다. 그는 다음 주 선전 APEC 정상회의에 이 대통령을 비롯한 여러 회원국 정상이 참석하기로 확정됐다며 한국이 지난해 경주 APEC 정상회의를 성공적으로 개최했다고 평가했다. 그러면서 "중한 양국이 잇따라 APEC 회의를 개최하는 만큼 손을 맞잡고 아시아태평양 공동체 건설을 함께 추진해 역내 공동 발전과 번영을 촉진해야 한다"고 말했다. 왕 부장은 한국이 중국의 APEC 개최 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.title_zh: 赵兑烈呼吁中国在半岛问题上发挥建设性作用；王毅表示政策没有改变（综合）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.body_zh: （北京、首尔＝韩联社）韩中阁特派记者金智宪报道＝外交部长赵显13日敦促中国在朝鲜半岛问题上发挥建设性作用。王毅表示，中国对朝鲜半岛的政策没有变化，并重申将持续为朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定发挥建设性作用。外交部表示，两国外长当日下午在北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行会谈并共进晚餐，历时3小时，就韩中关系、朝鲜半岛问题等双方共同关心的问题交换了意见。赵部长强调，朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定符合韩中两国的共同利益，并介绍了韩国政府为半岛无核化与和平实现所作的努力，同时敦促中国在朝鲜重返对话等半岛问题上发挥作用。王毅在回应时延续了近来未明确使用“无核化”表述的做法，但再次强调，中国既有的半岛无核化政策没有变化。王毅还表示，去年8月在首尔与赵部长举行外长会谈时曾提及，中国对半岛问题的立场具有连续性和稳定性。会谈中，赵部长表示，作为去年亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议主席国，韩国政府希望下周在宣城举行的APEC领导人会议取得圆满成功。他接着说，双方应做好充分准备，使两国领导人之间的交流成为推动韩中全面战略合作伙伴关系进一步成熟发展的重要契机。王毅评价，韩中关系的积极势头正从去年庆州延续至宣城，并表示欢迎李在明总统借APEC会议之机访问中国，将给予充分礼遇，确保此次访问取得成功。两位外长评价，通过去年和今年两国领导人相互进行国事访问所推动的韩中关系全面恢复趋势正在转化为具体成果，并就迎接明年建交35周年、持续为两国国民带来切实成果的多种方案进行了讨论。双方尤其同意，将通过推进韩中自由贸易协定（FTA）服务与投资谈判，进一步夯实两国平等、互利的经济合作基础，同时加强扩大两国国民之间的人员交流以及促进友好感情的努力。赵部长转达了韩国在黄海问题等议题上的原则立场，并敦促中国政府为保护在中国韩国国民的安全和权益而努力。外交部介绍，围绕这些议题，双方同意将审慎管控，避免其成为两国关系发展的障碍。会谈正式开始前，赵部长在全体发言中表示：“朝鲜半岛问题关系到韩国的切身利益，朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定符合两国共同利益。”“我们期待韩中两国继续加强战略沟通，为半岛局势取得进展作出贡献。”他接着说：“我们期待下周在宣城，两国领导人时隔10个月再次会晤，并以此为重要契机，推动韩中全面战略合作伙伴关系进一步成熟。”他还说：“希望从庆州开启的两位领导人之间的友谊与信任故事经由北京延续到宣城，同时期待韩中关系更加亲近。”赵部长评价，去年11月和今年1月两国领导人相互进行国事访问后，韩中关系全面恢复的趋势进一步巩固。他强调：“预计今年韩中人员交流将突破1000万人次，两国之间的贸易额也增长了40%以上。”“这是两国政府为落实两国领导人全面恢复关系的共同共识而紧密沟通、共同努力的结果。”赵部长补充说，希望通过此次会谈协商，推动下周两国领导人会晤取得成功。王毅在全体发言中评价：“去年底和今年初，习近平主席与李在明总统成功进行相互访问，推动中韩关系重回改善与发展的正确轨道。”他接着强调：“为筹备下一阶段的高层接触，必须做好充分准备。”“明年正值中韩建交35周年，两国应以此为契机共同努力，推动全面战略合作伙伴关系沿着正确轨道发展。”王毅预计，今年两国贸易额将创历史新高，人员往来也将恢复到每年1000万人左右的水平。他表示，包括李在明总统在内的多个成员国领导人已确定出席下周在宣城举行的APEC领导人会议，并评价韩国去年成功举办庆州APEC领导人会议。他表示：“既然韩中两国接连举办APEC会议，两国就应携手并进，共同推进建设亚太命运共同体，促进地区共同发展与繁荣。”王毅还高度评价韩国积极参与并助力中国筹备APEC会议，并期待宣城领导人会议为两国关系提供新动力。图片来源：KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和应用> 2026/11/13 23:47发稿 2026年11月13日23时47分发稿（北京＝韩联社）韩中阁特派记者＝13日下午，在中国北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行韩中外长会谈，外交部长赵显、中国外交部长王毅等人出席。2026.11.13.
